2026-11-28.title: Fourth Saturday of the Dedication of the Church · St Andrew the Apostle (anticipated)
2026-11-28.readTitle: Readings of the day (Syro-Malabar Liturgical Calendar)
readings: Jacob's dream: the gate of heaven
Let us go with you, for God is with you
How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news
2026-11-28.alt: Weekday readings: Revelation 21:22–27 (The Lord God and the Lamb are its temple); John 4:19–26 (Worship in spirit and truth). St Andrew (29 November) is kept today because 29 November is Sunday; patron's day of Archbishop Mar Andrews Thazhath. The new liturgical year begins tomorrow.
2026-11-28.verse: And he said to them, “Follow me, and I will make you fish for people.” Immediately they left their nets and followed him.
theo: On the last day of the liturgical year the weekday readings look at the heavenly city: “I saw no temple in the city, for its temple is the Lord God the Almighty and the Lamb.” Jesus tells the Samaritan woman that true worshippers will worship the Father “in spirit and truth”. The whole year of feasts and Sundays has been a school for that worship.

We also keep St Andrew, the first-called. In John's Gospel he is the first to follow Jesus and immediately brings his brother: “We have found the Messiah.” Andrew is the patron of everyone who brings another to Christ. As the new year begins tomorrow with the Annunciation, Andrew reminds us that the Good News is meant to be shared: “How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news!”
outline: Ask: whom did you bring closer to Christ this year?
Jacob discovers God in an ordinary place; the Church is the house of God.
Andrew's gift: introducing others to Jesus.
live: Invite someone to come with you to the Qurbana tomorrow.
Make a short review of this liturgical year in prayer.
saints: Brother of Peter, first-called, martyred, according to tradition, at Patras in Greece on an X-shaped cross.
2026-11-28.prayer: Lord Jesus, as this liturgical year ends, I thank you for all your gifts. Like Andrew, let me follow you at once and bring others to you, that we may worship the Father in spirit and truth. Amen.

quick: The heavenly city's temple is God and the Lamb.
Andrew followed at once and brought his brother.
The new year begins tomorrow: bring someone with you.

2026-11-28.question: Whom have I brought closer to Christ this year?

homily: Dear friends, on the last day of the season of the Dedication of the Church we see Jacob dreaming of a ladder set up on the earth, its top reaching to heaven, and the angels of God ascending and descending on it. Jacob wakes and says: this is none other than the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven (Genesis 28:12–17). Every church, every Holy Qurbana, is a gate of heaven.

Today we keep in advance the feast of St Andrew. By the Sea of Galilee Jesus calls Peter and Andrew: follow me, and I will make you fish for people. Immediately they left their nets and followed him (Matthew 4:19–20). Paul says that everyone who calls on the name of the Lord shall be saved; but how are they to hear without someone to proclaim him (Romans 10:13–14)?

The first thing Andrew did was to bring his brother to Jesus. Tomorrow the season of Annunciation begins. Decide today to bring one person to Jesus this Christmas season: your brother or sister, or a friend. Amen.
kids: Children, when Andrew met Jesus he ran and brought his brother. Invite a friend to church too!

intro: The last day of the year: the heavenly temple, worship in spirit and truth, and St Andrew who brings others to Jesus.

sub: Jacob finds God in an unexpected place.
Every church is a gate of heaven.
q: And he was afraid, and said, “How awesome is this place! This is none other than the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.”
I saw no temple in the city, for its temple is the Lord God the Almighty and the Lamb.

sub: Andrew and Peter leave their nets at once.
q: I am now sending for many fishermen, says the LORD, and they shall catch them.
And he said to them, “Follow me, and I will make you fish for people.” Immediately they left their nets and followed him.

sub: The nations will say: “Let us go with you, for God is with you.”
q: In those days ten men from nations of every language shall take hold of a Jew, grasping his garment and saying, “Let us go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.”
He first found his brother Simon and said to him, “We have found the Messiah.”
points.apply: Invite someone to the Qurbana tomorrow.

concl: The year ends where it began: with the house of God.
Tomorrow a new year begins; bring someone with you.
